answer: Each submission hangs on the cedar of a task receipt, and the delta is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
